company.name: BizConnect
company.shortDescription: BizConnect is a card scanning and network managing app that scans, digitizes, manages and visualize business contacts and lead performances.
company.description: BizConnect is an AI-powered business card scanner and contact management platform that helps professionals digitize, organize, and manage networking contacts efficiently. The app supports OCR-based card scanning in 30+ languages, CRM integrations, lead tracking, task management, and team collaboration. BizConnect integrates with Google Contacts, Outlook, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, and Zapier, enabling seamless workflow automation for businesses, sales teams, and entrepreneurs worldwide.
